paragraphs: At the start of the shift, they open the switchboard and answering systems and connect calls routed through headquarters within three seconds. During the morning peak, they handle more than a dozen calls in succession, calming urgent callers before finding the right contact. In the afternoon, they register a wave of visitors and issue access through the system, summarize messages for departments, and complete the handoff with the next day's visitor appointments clearly marked.
